<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>v1.1: percorre service_availability agrupada por service_commitment E service_offering e exclui somente quando esse par nao existe em service_offering_commitment. Outros vinculos do mesmo compromisso nao impedem a limpeza. Preserva cadastros e referencias a compromissos inexistentes. DRY_RUN=true simula; false exclui. Revalida o par antes de cada exclusao. Log inclui compromisso, oferta e quantidade. Correcao nao executada na implantacao.</description><name>LAB - Cleanup orphan Service Availabilit</name><record_for_rollback>true</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[/*
 * Global Fix Script - limpeza manual de disponibilidades sem offering relationship.
 * Valida o par Service Commitment + Service Offering de cada disponibilidade.
 * Preserva os cadastros e as disponibilidades dos pares ainda relacionados.
 * DRY_RUN=true apenas simula; false remove. Executar com Record for rollback marcado.
 */
(function () {
    var DRY_RUN = false;
    var SOURCE = 'CleanupOrphanServiceAvailability';
    var removedTotal = 0, candidateTotal = 0, skipped = 0, failures = 0;

    function log(message) { gs.info(message, SOURCE); }
    function hasRelationship(id, offeringId) {
        var relationship = new GlideRecord('service_offering_commitment');
        relationship.addQuery('service_commitment', id);
        relationship.addQuery('service_offering', offeringId);
        relationship.setLimit(1);
        relationship.query();
        return relationship.hasNext();
    }

    var availability = new GlideRecord('service_availability');
    var relationships = new GlideRecord('service_offering_commitment');
    if (!availability.isValid() || !availability.isValidField('service_commitment') ||
            !availability.isValidField('service_offering') || !relationships.isValid() ||
            !relationships.isValidField('service_commitment') || !relationships.isValidField('service_offering')) {
        gs.error('Schema invalido; nenhuma exclusao realizada.', SOURCE);
        return;
    }

    // A existencia de vinculo com OUTRA oferta nao preserva este par.
    var groups = new GlideAggregate('service_availability');
    groups.addNotNullQuery('service_commitment');
    groups.addNotNullQuery('service_offering');
    groups.addAggregate('COUNT');
    groups.groupBy('service_commitment');
    groups.groupBy('service_offering');
    groups.query();
    log('Inicio | Modo: ' + (DRY_RUN ? 'SIMULACAO' : 'EXCLUSAO'));

    while (groups.next()) {
        var commitmentId = groups.getValue('service_commitment');
        var offeringId = groups.getValue('service_offering');
        if (hasRelationship(commitmentId, offeringId)) { skipped++; continue; }

        var commitment = new GlideRecord('service_commitment');
        if (!commitment.get(commitmentId)) {
            gs.warn('Service Commitment ausente: ' + commitmentId +
                '; ignorado para revisao manual.', SOURCE);
            continue;
        }

        var removed = 0, candidates = 0, errors = 0;
        var offering = new GlideRecord('service_offering');
        var offeringName = offering.get(offeringId) ? offering.getDisplayValue() : '[Oferta inexistente]';
        var records = new GlideRecord('service_availability');
        records.addQuery('service_commitment', commitmentId);
        records.addQuery('service_offering', offeringId);
        records.query();
        while (records.next()) {
            // Revalida antes de cada exclusao para interromper se um vinculo surgir.
            if (hasRelationship(commitmentId, offeringId)) {
                gs.warn('Relacionamento identificado durante a execucao; interrompida a limpeza de ' +
                    commitmentId + ' / ' + offeringId, SOURCE);
                break;
            }
            candidates++;
            if (DRY_RUN) { continue; }
            var availabilityId = records.getUniqueValue();
            try {
                if (records.deleteRecord()) { removed++; }
                else {
                    errors++;
                    gs.error('Falha ao remover Service Availability: ' + availabilityId, SOURCE);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                errors++;
                gs.error('Falha ao remover Service Availability: ' + availabilityId + ' | ' + e, SOURCE);
            }
        }
        candidateTotal += candidates;
        removedTotal += removed;
        failures += errors;
        log('Service Commitment: ' + commitment.getDisplayValue() + ' - ' + commitmentId +
            '; Service Offering: ' + offeringName + ' - ' + offeringId +
            '; Offering Relationship: ' + (hasRelationship(commitmentId, offeringId) ? 'Identificado durante a execucao' : 'Não Identificado') +
            '; Service Availability: ' + removed + ' Removidos' +
            (DRY_RUN ? '; Simulacao: ' + candidates + ' candidatos' : '') +
            '; Falhas: ' + errors);
    }
    log('Fim | Candidatos: ' + candidateTotal + '; Removidos: ' + removedTotal +
        '; Pares preservados com relacionamento: ' + skipped + '; Falhas: ' + failures);
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>chatgpt.codex</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-20 00:26:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>1b153fd5c348df18e079b13ed401310f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LAB - Cleanup orphan Service Availabilit</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_1b153fd5c348df18e079b13ed401310f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>chatgpt.codex</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-20 21:54:22</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>
